name: com.superanretan.remotecontrol
description: Universal remote control system for Unity. One build = Host (3D scene), another = Controller (UI). Native path over Unity Transport; WebGL controller <-> Apple Vision Pro host over WebRTC (signaling on Vercel + Redis, screen streaming, host->controller return channel). Commands are JSON dispatched to handlers via ScriptableObject event channels. No singletons, no static, handler-based.

samples.description: Host scene with a color-changing cube and Controller scene with UI buttons. Demonstrates the full command pipeline over local Wi-Fi.
